data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 conflates activation-trajectory divergence with independence, but its own counterconditions expose the flaw: if both paths remain in the same attractor basin or the perturbation cannot overcome self-consistency bias, the perturbation yields only apparent independence. The target offers no evidence within a single run's record that distinguishes genuine independent verification via perturbation from mere restatement under noise—exactly what the problem asks it to identify.
